source.fangraphs: leaders/major-league team splits (type=8); month=0 season, month=1 last 7 days; blend=equal-weight avg
source.kalshi: Kalshi MLB Game Winner markets (api.elections.kalshi.com) volume_fp per side

formulas.kalshiMult: side_volume / other_side_volume (Ticker Tracker Game Winner volume ratio)
formulas.note: Positive diffs / Overall Edge favor the home team. Edges are recomputed per stats window. SZN + L7 averages season and last-7 team stats equally before diffs/z-scores. Money column is Kalshi Game Winner dollar volume per team.
